about: S2 of docs/plans/obsidian-update-robustness.md. Obsidian internals Lab Kit relies on (classes Obsidian draws, members of app missing from its typings, files that cast app). tests/obsidian-internals.test.ts fails when src/, styles.css or the kits use one that is not listed, or a listed one is gone.
